subject: Winston Chang to work on ggplot2 full-time

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Winston Chang to work on ggplot2 full-time
parts:
Hi all,

I'm pleased to announce that I've hired Winston Chang to work on
ggplot2. Winston is a recent graduate of Northwestern University, with
a Ph.D. in Cognitive Psychology, and is probably a familiar name if
you read this mailing list regularly. He created the "Cookbook for R"
website and is currently working on a book on visualising data with R,
to be published by O'Reilly Media.

Here's a word from Winston:

Hi everyone - Up until now I've enjoyed working on ggplot2 in my spare
time, and I'm looking forward to working on it full time now. Here are
some projects
I have planned:

- A visual testing system to reduce the number of new bugs introduced to ggplot2

- Revamping the ggplot2 website

- Converting the ggplot2 code base from proto to S3 methods

- Helping to modernise ggplot2 and help it deal with bigger datasets

Regards,

Hadley and Winston

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
http://had.co.nz/
